summary: Proposal for operator passkey sign-in and per-action step-up on the device-admin routes (#2894), with owner decisions D1, D2 and D6 recorded and D3-D5, D7-D11 open. Only slice S1 is implemented: off-host raw operator-credential use is observed and still allowed, and the host desktop app's local-grant credential is pinned as list-only.
limits: Sections 2-7 describe unbuilt mechanisms (passkeys, sessions, step-up, consent-origin ceremony) and are design claims, not implementation evidence. WebAuthn RP ID statements are reasoned from the specification. No live desktop, paired-browser or tailnet run; the device-session cookie's refusal status is not verified. Line citations drift with later edits.
checks: Full document read against the reviewed draft; S1 sections re-read at c2c67c2f25 against the predicate, the four device-admin routes and the production wiring.

operator-credential-host-locality.test.ts executed through the real runtime-http boundary and a real EnvironmentSecurityService: 10/10 pass; device-pairing-routes and pairing-approval-auth-tier 118/118 pass.
